ModMetaData.name: [oks]rimwitch
ModMetaData.author: milai_oks_sakura
ModMetaData.description:
RimWitch is a witcher-flavoured content mod for RimWorld 1.7.
It adds three alchemical herbs — crow's eye, honeysuckle and ribleaf — and the silver-weakness rule: a creature flagged as a monster takes only a tenth of the damage from anything that is not silver. That rule is data-driven, so other mods can hook their own monsters and silver weapons into the same system.
The alchemy loop is in development: an alchemy bench, monster parts taken from beasts, and recipes that turn them into decoctions that heal over time, potions that restore a colonist on the spot, and blade oils that bite harder against a chosen kind of prey.
Requires Harmony.
